logp.method_description: The lipophilicity of the [(CH3)2NH2]trans-[RuCl4(HmtpO)2] (1a) and cisplatin was determined using the shake-flask method. Aqueous (0.9% v/v) sodium chloride and organic (n-octanol) phases were saturated for 1 week. (1a) and cisplatin were dissolved at a concentration of 0.30 mg/mL in 2.5 mL of saturated aqueous phase. An equal volume of n-octanol was added, and the solutions were mechanically mixed for 30 min, followed by centrifugation. After separation, the phases were analyzed using UV-Vis spectroscopy to determine the amount of the compound in each phase. The partition coefficient (log P) in both phases for each compound was calculated based on the Lambert-Beer Law. The procedures were repeated ten times.
